headline: As of 2026-10-28: 37,298,140 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 37,298,140 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,497,036), California (3,768,035), Florida (3,563,317).
